# alenkazoloto.github.io

Serves `/.well-known/assetlinks.json` at the root of this GitHub Pages account — the one
address [Android App Links verification](https://developer.android.com/training/app-links/verify-android-applinks)
reads, per host. It lets a link to `https://alenkazoloto.github.io/agents-deck/pair` (the Agent Deck pairing QR)
open the app directly instead of a browser.

Holds nothing else. The plugin's own site — privacy policy, terms, the pairing page — is a
separate *project* site at `https://alenkazoloto.github.io/agents-deck/`, published by `scripts/publish-site.sh`
from the plugin repository; GitHub Pages serves the account root only from a repository named
exactly this one, which is why the two cannot be the same repository.
